controls.title: Protection of Audit Information

gaps.title: Account Management
gaps.gap: No account lifecycle evidence exists in the telemetry: agents are identified by name strings in events, with no provisioning, review, or deprovisioning records.
gaps.remediation: Emit identity lifecycle events from the platform's agent registry into the store.

gaps.title: Identification and Authentication
gaps.gap: No authentication events: nothing in the record proves a producer or agent cryptographically is who it claims to be. The hash chain proves records were not altered after the fact, not who wrote them.
gaps.remediation: Sign events at emission (per-producer keys) and record verification in the store.

gaps.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures
gaps.gap: No evidence of alerting or fallback behavior when event emission or storage itself fails.
gaps.remediation: Record emission failures and alert on store-append errors; test by fault injection.

gaps.title: Audit Record Retention
gaps.gap: No retention policy or archive artifact: the store is a file with no stated retention period, rotation, or archival record.
gaps.remediation: Adopt and publish a retention schedule; record archival events.

gaps.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
gaps.gap: No transport evidence (TLS configuration, protected channels) exists in the telemetry; producers write to a local store in this deployment.
gaps.remediation: For networked deployments, record channel configuration and emit connection security events.

gaps.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
gaps.gap: The chain uses SHA-256 hashing only. No key management artifacts exist because no signing/encryption keys are managed by the platform.
gaps.remediation: If event signing is adopted (see IA-2), document key generation, storage, and rotation.

gaps.title: Protection of Information at Rest
gaps.gap: The store is plaintext JSONL. Payloads are producer audit excerpts; there is no encryption at rest and no redaction stage at capture, so sensitive content in a tool result could persist verbatim.
gaps.remediation: Add a redaction stage at ingestion (the gateway's screening patterns are a starting set) and encrypt archived stores.

gaps.title: Control Assessments
gaps.gap: This pack organizes evidence; it is not an assessment. No assessor determination, control interview, or examination record exists here.
gaps.remediation: An independent assessor reviews this pack against the source publications and records determinations separately.

gaps.title: Risk Assessment
gaps.gap: No formal risk assessment document (threats, likelihoods, organizational impact) is among the artifacts; chaos scenarios characterize technical failure modes only.
gaps.remediation: Produce and version a risk assessment that the scenario catalog references.

gaps.title: Awareness Training / Personnel Security
gaps.gap: Organizational controls: no training records, role definitions, or personnel artifacts can be evidenced by platform telemetry.
gaps.remediation: Evidence lives in organizational systems; reference it in the SSP, not in this pack.

gaps.title: Organizational policies and accountability (GOVERN)
gaps.gap: The pack evidences executable governance (policy in code, approval gates). It does not evidence organizational governance: AI risk policies, accountable roles, or risk-tolerance decisions by named humans.
gaps.remediation: Attach the organization's AI governance charter and decision log as documentary evidence alongside this pack.

gaps.title: Context of use and impact characterization (MAP)
gaps.gap: Beyond the failure-mode catalog, there is no documented context-of-use analysis, affected-party analysis, or impact characterization among the artifacts.
gaps.remediation: Write and version a MAP document per deployed workload; reference its scenarios from the chaos catalog.

disclaimer: This pack organizes machine-generated evidence from an agent platform's audit store. It is evidence organization, not a compliance certification, not an assessor determination, and not an Authorization to Operate. Control summaries are paraphrases; interpretations are labeled as such. Authority rests with the source publications and the assessing body.

tamper_demonstration.detail: hash mismatch: stored event content was altered
tamper_demonstration.meaning: A deliberately altered copy of the store fails verification at the exact altered sequence — the tamper-detection property AU-9 relies on, demonstrated on a real artifact rather than asserted.
